## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include story and business-rule IDs.

## Verification

Record commands, results, and relevant acceptance-test IDs. Explain any check you could not run.

## Review notes

List unresolved defects, setup changes, or decisions the reviewer needs to assess. Link updated documentation.

- [ ] I checked the affected acceptance criteria.
- [ ] I recorded verification evidence.
- [ ] I updated setup or requirements documents where behavior changed.
